blocks.text: Module test A1.3 · The verb
Instructions
Week 37 of the calendar, after verification A1-11 → A1-15. Duration: approx. 80 minutes for parts A/D, plus 10 minutes of oral examination. Fix it with the solution.
Overcoming. At least 38 points above 50 (75%) and at least 2 in each criterion of the headings. If you do not exceed: one week on the weakest unit, then re-read the sections below 75%.
A · Reading (10 points)
⁧أَرْبَعَةُ مُتَرْجِمِينَ وَمُحَاسِبٌ⁩ : ⁧فِي الشَّرِكَةِ سَبْعَةُ مُوَظَّفِينَ⁩ . ⁧فِي مِيلَانُو شَرِكَةٌ صَغِيرَةٌ لِلتَّرْجَمَةِ⁩
⁧مُدِيرَةُ الشَّرِكَةِ اسْمُهَا⁩ . ⁧المُتَرْجِمُونَ يَعْمَلُونَ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ وَالفَرَنْسِيَّةِ وَالإِنْجْلِيزِيَّةِ⁩ . ⁧وَمُبَرْمِجَانِ⁩
⁧يَدْخُلُ المُوَظَّفُونَ المَكْتَبَ صَبَاحًا وَيَخْرُجُونَ مَسَاءً، لٰكِنِ المُبَرْمِجَانِ لَا⁩ . ⁧رِيم، وَهِيَ سُورِيَّةٌ⁩
⁧تُتَرْجِمُ الشَّرِكَةُ وَثَائِقَ لِلْمَحَاكِمِ وَالمُسْتَشْفَيَاتِ⁩ . ⁧يَعْمَلَانِ مِنَ البَيْتِ⁩ : ⁧يَعْمَلَانِ فِي المَكْتَبِ⁩
. ⁧الوَثَائِقُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَالعَمَلُ صَعْبٌ، لٰكِنِ المُوَظَّفُونَ سُعَدَاءُ⁩ . ⁧وَالشَّرِكَاتِ⁩

Help: ⁧التَّرْجَمَة⁩ The translation is done. ⁧تُتَرْجِمُ⁩ • Translate • ⁧وَثَائِق⁩ • documents • ⁧المَحَاكِم⁩ The Courts of Justice ⁧سُعَدَاءُ⁩ Happy (plural) ⁧سَعِيد⁩ ). Reply in English (2 points for complete response, 1 if partial).
1. How many employees does the company have and what do they do?
2. In which languages do interpreters work?
3. Who runs the company?
4. Where do the programmers work, and the other employees?
5. Who does the company translate for? How's the job and how are the employees?
B · Listening (8 points)
Listen to the call twice. Answer in English; 2 points per answer.
1. What do you want? Karīm And for when?
2. Why is that not possible? What does the employee propose?
3. What is the phone number of Karīm?
4. Who will call him and when?
C · Language (12 points)

One point for an answer. Conjugation. Write the verb: 1. ( ⁧أَنْتِ، يَدْرُسُ⁩ ) · 2. ( ⁧نَحْنُ، يَعْرِفُ⁩ ) · 3. ( ⁧هُمْ، يَسْكُنُ⁩ ) Denial. Deny: 4. . ⁧أَفْهَمُ الدَّرْسَ⁩ · 5. . ⁧يَعْمَلُونَ مَسَاءً⁩ Plural and agreement. 6. Plural of ⁧مُهَنْدِسَة⁩ · 7. Correct: ⁧الكُتُبُ جَدِيدُونَ⁩ · 8. Translate: "These are my colleagues." 9. Write in letters: ⁧٨⁩ · 10. Write your age with a full sentence. Dual and plural subject. 11. Translate: "The two colleagues work here" (verb before). · 12. Translate: .. Students study in the library (subject before).
D · Written production (8 points)

Write about 70 words, vocalized, about your work or study: what you do during the day; what your colleagues or companions do (at least three verbs in the plural or dual); two things you don't do ( ⁧لَا⁩ ); at least three plurals, one of which is with an agreement to the singular female; a number in letters. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Register 1–4. Each missing mandatory item removes 1 Point to Accuracy (minimum 1).
E · Oral production: monologue (12 points)
1. Talk for a minute, without reading, about your kind of day and your work.
2. Answer three questions from the tutor (for example: ⁧مَاذَا يَعْمَلُ زُمَلَاؤُكَ؟ هَلْ تَعْمَلُ يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ؟ كَمْ شَخْصًا⁩
⁧فِي فَرِيقِكَ؟⁩ ).
Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity 1–4 + Speak 1–4. For Fluidity, level 3: One minute with a maximum of four breaks to search for verbal forms.
